items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begin when the medical waiting period ends.

Retirement plan eligibility is different and shorter: an employee may begin contributing to the 401(k) plan from their first payroll run, with no waiting period at all.

Next steps:
- If you have questions about your specific eligibility date, contact People Operations at benefits@mosaicrobotics.example

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for a bulk personal-data extract over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Recommendation — not company policy: This is a phishing attempt. Watch for red flags: urgency that does not match the sender's usual tone, a request to move conversation to a personal channel, links where displayed text differs from destination, requests for credentials or payment changes, unexpected attachments, or approaches from someone senior arriving out of the blue.

Next steps:
- Forward the message to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not reply to the sender

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories. The allowance resets on 1 January and does not carry over.

Next steps:
- Review the list of eligible items (desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, small filing cabinet)
- Note that tech items like monitors, laptops, keyboards and headsets are not eligible under this allowance
- Submit claims in MosaicOne Expenses

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent. The 16 weeks are the same whether the employee gave birth, did not give birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement leading to adoption.

Next steps:
- Review eligibility requirements (6 months continuous service)
- Discuss timing and scheduling options with your manager and People Operations

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Where the cap cannot be met — a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market — the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason. No pre-approval is needed; the note is enough.

Next steps:
- Confirm your destination city to determine which cap applies
- Contact MosaicOne Travel if your destination has inflated rates due to company conferences

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request is raised in MosaicOne alongside the manager approval and names the destination, the exact dates, the workspace address and a short description of the work the employee will perform while abroad.

A trip that exceeds 30 consecutive days also requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

A review has one of three outcomes: Approved — the trip proceeds as requested. Approved with conditions — the trip proceeds with named restrictions, most often a prohibition on customer-facing activity and a hard end date. Not approved — the exposure cannot be managed at a reasonable cost, and the employee is offered an alternative destination or a shorter stay.

Next steps:
- Submit Tax & Legal review request in MosaicOne at least 21 calendar days before departure
- Obtain director approval (not just manager approval)
- Provide destination, exact dates, workspace address, and work description in the review request
- Await Tax & Legal determination before finalizing travel plans

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports are approved in MosaicOne against the thresholds below. A direct manager may approve expense reports up to USD 2,500. A director may approve expense reports up to USD 10,000. For a USD 3,000 report total, the approver is a Director with Finance business partner review.

Next steps:
- Submit the trip in MosaicOne Travel at least 14 days before departure with manager approval
- Obtain director approval for the USD 3,000 expense report in MosaicOne
- Retain itemised receipts for all expenses of USD 25 or more

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. It is the only training with a hard deadline shorter than 30 days, because system access is granted on day one and the risk starts with it.

The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption. All four are completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. Enrolling early means the elections are in place when eligibility arrives.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. An employee has 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. The shipment contains the laptop, adapter, headset and, for remote hires, the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock.

Recommendation — not company policy: Complete benefits elections during week one so they are in place when your 90-day waiting period ends and coverage becomes eligible. Attend a People Operations benefits question session (held every second Tuesday) if you need clarification on plan options.

Next steps:
- Complete security and acceptable-use training within 14 days of start date
- Complete all four required trainings (security, data protection, anti-harassment, anti-bribery) by day 30
- Enrol in 401(k) and make benefits elections in week one
- Verify device setup (laptop, peripherals) is complete before day one

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Severity 1 cases cover immediate risk to a person: violence or a threat of it, a safety incident with injury, a credible risk of self-harm, sexual misconduct involving physical contact, and any matter where someone must be separated from a situation today. Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example or Employee Relations at employee-relations@mosaicrobotics.example to raise a case
- For anonymous reports, use the third-party ethics line published in MosaicOne

As a hybrid employee assigned to a hub office, you are required to work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by your team, not by you individually, to ensure team onsite days overlap for collaborative office time; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne rather than week by week.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your office assignment is Boston (timezone America/New_York), and your manager is Dana (Director, Engineering). Your work arrangement is hybrid in the United States.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager Dana
- Review your rolling four-week average compliance in MosaicOne

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on your office calendar.

Unforeseeable absences—sudden illness, family emergency, or transport failure—are never held to the notice requirement. You notify your manager as early as reasonably possible, and the absence is entered in MosaicOne retroactively.

Next steps:
- Submit your PTO request in MosaicOne with the required advance notice
- Coordinate with your manager to ensure coverage

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Every PTO request requires written approval from the employee's direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, a message in chat and an email thread are all insufficient on their own: the approval must be recorded against the request so the audit trail is complete.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your current PTO balance as of 2026-09-01 is 13.5 days, which covers the 3 days you are requesting. You have sufficient accrual to take this time off. Submit your request in MosaicOne now to allow your manager time to approve it in writing before your requested dates.

Recommendation — not company policy: Verify that your request meets the 5 business day notice requirement by counting business days from your submission date in MosaicOne to Tuesday 15 September 2026, excluding the submission day and any company holidays.

Next steps:
- Submit the PTO request in MosaicOne for 3 days (15–17 September 2026)
- Ensure your manager approves the request in writing within 3 business days
- Confirm the notice requirement is met before the first day of absence

You meet the tenure requirement: employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country. Your tenure as of 2026-09-01 is 45 months.

Your proposed stay of 42 consecutive days (3 November to 14 December, inclusive) exceeds the 30-day threshold and therefore requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins, director approval (not just manager approval), and written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your 42-day stay falls within the rolling 90-day annual limit for work outside your home country.

Work performed outside your home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. You must notify IT Security of the destination at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules can be adjusted.

Recommendation — not company policy: Tax & Legal review typically approves stays over 30 days with conditions, most often a prohibition on customer-facing activity and a hard end date. Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates and workspace address at least 21 calendar days before 3 November.

Escalation: File your Tax & Legal review request and obtain director approval through People Operations at mobility@mosaicrobotics.example to confirm all three approvals (manager, director, Tax & Legal) are in place before departure.

Next steps:
- Raise manager approval request in MosaicOne at least 21 calendar days before 3 November with destination, exact dates, and workspace address.
- File Tax & Legal review request at least 21 calendar days before departure.
- Obtain director approval (required for stays exceeding 30 consecutive days).
- Confirm with IT Security that your travel laptop is company-managed, encrypted, and on always-on VPN, and notify them of Germany at least 5 business days before departure.
